Unit test generation was requested by @Phazzie.

* https://github.com/Phazzie/meechiescoloringbook/pull/73#issuecomment-4477804934

The following files were modified:

* `src/lib/seams/auth-context-seam/test.ts`
* `src/lib/seams/chat-interpretation-seam/test.ts`
* `src/lib/seams/creation-store-seam/test.ts`
* `tests/unit/generate-contract.test.ts`
* `tests/unit/image-generation-wire-contract.test.ts`

## Summary by Sourcery

Add comprehensive schema and seam contract tests for auth, chat interpretation, creation storage, and image/generation API wire formats to validate updated seam-sourced imports and adapter behavior.

Tests:
- Add wire-format contract tests for image generation schemas covering encodings, formats, input/output constraints, and result envelope shapes.
- Add generate API contract tests to validate request/response schemas, including style hints, page sizes, violations, and result envelopes.
- Add creation store seam tests using fixtures to verify mock behavior, browser/localStorage adapter behavior, and schema validation failures.
- Add chat interpretation seam tests using fixtures and mocked fetch to cover success, fault, network error, invalid response handling, and HTTP payload shape.
- Add auth context seam tests using fixtures to validate mock and adapter outputs and sessionId validation edge cases.

## Reviewer's Guide Adds CodeRabbit-generated unit and contract tests for several seams (auth context, chat interpretation, creation store) and for the generate and image-generation wire contracts, exercising success, error, and edge-case flows without changing production code. ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Add contract tests for AuthContextSeam covering fixture-backed mocks, adapter behavior, and sessionId validation edge cases. |
  • Define a zod-based fixture schema and validate sample and fault auth context fixtures before use.
  • Add tests that verify the auth context mock returns sample and fault fixtures as-is.
  • Add adapter tests for normal fixture-based responses and anonymous-context behavior when sessionId is absent or empty.
  • Add negative tests ensuring invalid sessionId formats yield SESSION_ID_INVALID and valid formats are accepted with expected rateLimitTier.
| `src/lib/seams/auth-context-seam/test.ts` | | Add contract and adapter tests for ChatInterpretationSeam, including network behavior and error handling around the /api/chat-interpretation endpoint. |
  • Define and validate a zod fixture schema for chat interpretation sample and fault fixtures.
  • Introduce a vi-based global fetch mock with per-test setup/teardown to simulate backend responses.
  • Add tests confirming mocks and adapter return sample and fault fixtures correctly, including request routing through the adapter.
  • Add network error handling tests for thrown errors, non-contract payloads, non-Error rejections, and correct POST body/headers to /api/chat-interpretation.
| `src/lib/seams/chat-interpretation-seam/test.ts` | | Add contract and adapter tests for CreationStoreSeam using fixture-backed mocks and jsdom localStorage behavior. |
  • Define a zod fixture schema that validates sample and fault fixtures for all creation and draft operations.
  • Add tests ensuring the mock implementation returns the exact fixture outputs for both sample and fault scenarios across save/list/get/delete and draft operations.
  • Add adapter tests for non-browser environments to confirm browser-gated fault behavior when localStorage is unavailable.
  • Add jsdom-based adapter tests that exercise saving, listing, getting, deleting creations and drafts via localStorage, including missing-entity behavior and schema-mismatch error handling.
| `src/lib/seams/creation-store-seam/test.ts` | | Add schema validation tests for the /api/generate wire-format contract to ensure seam-sourced imports still produce valid schemas. |
  • Create a canonical valid spec and image fixture used across tests.
  • Add GenerateRequestSchema tests for required spec presence, valid/invalid styleHint, enum and numeric-boundary validation (colorMode, variations, pageSize).
  • Add GenerateResponseValueSchema tests covering required fields, optional revisedPrompt/modelMetadata, violations/recommendedFixes arrays, invalid image formats, and multi-image support.
  • Add GenerateResultSchema tests for ok/fault variants, invalid ok values, and error objects missing required fields.
| `tests/unit/generate-contract.test.ts` | | Add schema validation tests for image-generation wire-format schemas to verify encoding, image metadata, input/output contracts, and result wrapper behavior. |
  • Introduce a shared valid coloring-page spec fixture reused across image generation tests.
  • Add ImageDataEncodingSchema tests for accepted encodings and rejection of unknown values.
  • Add GeneratedImageSchema tests for accepted formats/encodings and rejection of invalid formats, encodings, empties, and missing required fields.
  • Add ImageGenerationInputSchema tests for prompt non-emptiness, variations boundaries and integer constraint, outputFormat enum, and presence of spec.
  • Add ImageGenerationOutputSchema tests for images array behavior, optional revisedPrompt/modelMetadata with validation, and mixed-format images.
  • Add ImageGenerationResultSchema tests for ok and fault variants, including invalid ok values, missing value for ok:true, and invalid error codes.

Hey - I've left some high level feedback:

- The `validSpec` and `validImage` objects are duplicated across `image-generation-wire-contract.test.ts` and `generate-contract.test.ts`; consider extracting shared contract fixtures into a common test helper to reduce duplication and keep contract changes localized.
- Several tests branch on `typeof localStorage === 'undefined'` to decide behavior; you might want a small test utility (e.g., `isBrowserLikeEnv()`) or use `it.skip`/separate suites to make the browser vs non‑browser expectations more explicit and avoid silently no‑op tests.

<details>
<summary>Prompt for AI Agents</summary>

- The `validSpec` and `validImage` objects are duplicated across `image-generation-wire-contract.test.ts` and `generate-contract.test.ts`; consider extracting shared contract fixtures into a common test helper to reduce duplication and keep contract changes localized.
- Several tests branch on `typeof localStorage === 'undefined'` to decide behavior; you might want a small test utility (e.g., `isBrowserLikeEnv()`) or use `it.skip`/separate suites to make the browser vs non‑browser expectations more explicit and avoid silently no‑op tests.
~~~

</details>
